subject: Re: Sapphire AI — volume mix, model differential & draft commercial terms
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Jack Hayes <jack.hayes@sapphire.ai>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sapphire AI — initial pricing thoughts & next steps

Hi Jack,

Great speaking earlier — appreciate you walking through the usage profile. To recap, you expect a hybrid workload over the next 12 months: high-volume embeddings for search (~60% of tokens), intermittent chat completions for customer-facing assistants (~30%), and a small set of RLHF-style long-form generations (~10%).

Two things we'd like to propose for the Hosted API:
- Volume-mix pricing: tiered per-token slabs with a blended effective rate that reflects your 60/30/10 split.
- Model differential: a 1.4x premium for the latest premium chat model (low latency), and a 1.2x uplift for the premium embedding model versus our standard family.

I've attached the profile you sent and a first-pass ratecard. I'd like to schedule a follow-up to walk the commercial map (MAP) — can you and procurement make time next week?

Action items for us before then:
- Stephanie: prepare a blended example invoice showing monthly spend at three forecasted tiers.
- Aditya: confirm if we can offer a limited first-quarter usage credit for onboarding latency-sensitive flows.

Thanks — happy to be flexible on structure; we want something predictable for you and sustainable for both sides.

Best,

Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

Attachment: Sapphire_Monthly-Profile.csv (csv)
Attachment: Redwood-Hosted-Ratecard-v2.pdf (pdf)
From: Jack Hayes <jack.hayes@sapphire.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sapphire AI — initial pricing thoughts & next steps

Stephanie — thanks for the quick recap. Couple of clarifications on our side:

1) The 60/30/10 split is our current estimate; search (embeddings) could spike to 75% if we move more of intent processing offline.
2) For the premium embedding model, we care most about vector quality at 512-dim and batch pricing for large ingest windows.
3) Procurement will want a simple slab discount by monthly token volume, but they also asked about carve-outs for test/staging traffic.

We can meet Tue 6 July 11am PT. Procurement will loop in Lena Ortiz (cc'd on later threads) for contract details. For the premium model uplift: would Redwood consider a lower uplift for embeddings (1.1x) if we commit to a higher invoice minimum?

– Jack

To: Jack Hayes <jack.hayes@sapphire.ai>, procurement@sapphire.ai, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@sapphire.ai>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Jul 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sapphire AI — volume carve-outs and uplift options

Jack / team — thanks for confirming the slot. Agenda for Tue 11am PT:
- Forecast walk (Sapphire_Monthly-Profile)
- Slab bands and how test/staging carve-outs would be handled (metering + tags)
- Model differential options and conditional reductions tied to invoice minimums
- Onboarding credits / MAP milestones

Pre-read: I've attached a draft MAP (MAP_Sapphire_v1.docx) that proposes a 12-month blended reservation with three slabs: 0-2B tokens, 2B-8B, >8B. The draft suggests: standard model base price, premium chat 1.4x, premium embed 1.2x with an option to drop premium embed to 1.1x if you sign to >6B/mo effective committed volume for months 4–12.

Aditya — can you confirm whether we can extend a Q1 onboarding credit (one-month equivalent) for latency-sensitive rollout? Marissa — can you prepare a sample blended invoice + simple clause for staging/test carve-outs (tagging-based exclusion)?

Thanks all — talk Tuesday.

Best,

Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP_Sapphire_v1.docx, Sapphire_Monthly-Profile.csv
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@sapphire.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jack Hayes <jack.hayes@sapphire.ai>, procurement@sapphire.ai
Date: Sat, 10 Jul 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Final commercial ask and next steps (DocuSign)

Thanks for the walkthrough on Tuesday — the team appreciated the clarity. A few final asks before legal routes the SOW to signature:

- Could Redwood produce a single-sheet summary that shows: (a) committed slabs, (b) blended effective rate examples at 3 traffic mixes (baseline 60/30/10, embeddings-heavy 75/20/5, chat-heavy 40/50/10), and (c) the conditional premium uplift reductions if the >6B/mo threshold is met?
- Please include explicit language for staging/test carve-outs referencing tagging/reporting (we prefer simple "exclude tags: staging, test, CI" with monthly reconciliation).
- Confirm onboarding credit: one month of equivalent usage credit applied to month 2 if onboarding milestones A+B are met.

If those items are in place, procurement will route the MAP to legal and we can e-sign. Can you also add a single line in the SOW referencing the premium-embedding 1.1x uplift when the >6B threshold is reached?

Lena Ortiz
Senior Procurement Manager, Sapphire AI
procurement@sapphire.ai
